source_refs.note: Inheritance of Rh Blood Groups: a main subheading of 18.4.2 Rh Blood Group System, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 95-95.

blocks.text: Rh blood group system is controlled a gene “D”. It has two alleles (D and d). The dominant allele D forms the Rh-antigen, while the recessive allele d inhibits the formation of Rh-antigen. Therefore, individuals with genotypes DD or Dd have Rh-antigen and are Rh-positive. While the individuals with genotype dd do not have Rh-antigen and are Rh-negative.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The book says the recessive allele d inhibits the formation of Rh-antigen. In fact d simply does not form the Rh (D) antigen; if it inhibited it, Dd people would be Rh-negative, but they are Rh-positive, as the next sentence says.
